cpu_submission: at most8 outstanding CPU jobs for the entire user in waves; inspect accepted/completed IDs, no dependency bypass or duplicate; serial user limit10 respected

phase_source_policy.choice: R-2(i): exact source identity, no cross-source cache reuse
phase_source_policy.freeze_period: before first extraction checkout through chain completion; unrelated FT15 source development on separate branch/worktree
phase_source_policy.invalidation: any covered source change invalidates all twelve extraction receipts under the amended code, including resource-only changes
phase_source_policy.action: stop chain; preserve all artifacts; no receipt rewrite, accepted-source whitelist or automatic resubmission
phase_source_policy.repeat_requires: new Claude review, new IDs/outputs, complete new estimate and Simone decision; all twelve extractions repeated
phase_source_policy.additional_cpu: checkout, benchmark and later CPU work must be re-estimated

numeric_thread_policy.classification_baseline_comparison: exact numeric_sha256 equality with both pinned historical P1/P2 reports; mismatch stops execution

first_extraction_quota_rule: owner reads fresh project quota immediately before first extraction submission; below32GiB no extraction is submitted; no implicit SCRATCH fallback
